title.en: Grand Opening of Viva Miches Resort by Wyndham in the Caribbean

content.en: Our CEO mr saed alghanam At the prestigious grand opening of Viva Miches resort by wyndham in the Caribbean — one of the most important and high-profile hospitality projects in the entire region — Wadi Degla proudly stood as the exclusive supplier of all marble used throughout the resort , including the floors, wall ,stairs , cladding, and countertops. This iconic development showcases the exceptional quality, elegance, and durability of our materials across every space. I had the honor of attending this remarkable event alongside Mr. Ettore Collusi, President of Viva resorts by wyndham , mss Dominique Colussi the general coordinator for all viva resorts and Mr. Claudio Natella  the Operations Manager for all Viva Resorts, whose leadership and coordination were instrumental to the project’s success. Our trusted Caribbean representative, ensured smooth execution and high-level oversight on site. The grand opening was further elevated by the presence of His Excellency Luis Abinader  the President of the Dominican Republic and and Mr Gustavo Viescas  the President of Wyndham Hotels Latin America — and his excellency David Collado  the minister of tourism of dominican republic — a testament to the global impact and significance of this project.

title.en: On-Site Project Inspection in the Caribbean

content.en:
Our team carried out a comprehensive on-site visit in the Caribbean to review and monitor the progress of ongoing projects supplied by Wadi Degla. The projects feature premium marble and granite materials sourced from both our Egypt and Turkey branches, reflecting our global supply capabilities.

During the visit, we closely assessed installation quality, adherence to design specifications, and overall project execution to ensure everything aligns with our high standards. This hands-on approach allows us to maintain consistency, support our partners on the ground, and guarantee that every project delivers exceptional results in both performance and aesthetics.
